problem: Lateral obstacle reaction inherited a hurdle-clearance trajectory that elevated the entire actor before the roll. The visible foot was unconstrained while the controller lifted the root.
change: Sideways contact now locks the impacting sole in world space, compresses the hip/knee chain, tilts/twists the pelvis and blends into the existing generated roll. Both low and high obstacles use clear approach-side ground space; no vault-like elevation or obstacle crossing.
method: Kinematic contact constraints and two-bone IK over existing Kimodo takes; not new neural inference or a rigid-body force simulation.

contact.blocked_foot: Leading sole selected from the displayed collision pose; clamp at near collider face, hold at floor+18mm
contact.joints: Original hip/knee/ankle bone lengths preserved; knee pole follows the captured leg with forward flexion bias
contact.torso: Pelvis drops and rolls/twists while the blocked foot stays fixed
contact.transition: Per-seed shared-body source entry timing skips generated idle/preparatory steps; contact solve blends out into the original fall/recovery

scope: A contact-aware animation prototype. Anchored sole and bone guides do not certify complete mesh/obstacle contacts, dynamic balance, physical forces or martial-arts technique.
exports: Save take includes the planted-foot solve, controller travel and chosen seed events. Individual generated-source exports preserve the original motion and omit runtime contact constraints.
